# Building the submission document

Produces `Vigil_Digital_Assignment_1.docx` at the repository root — a single Word
document containing all five assignment deliverables.

## One-time setup

```bash
pip install cairosvg pillow
cd docs/build && npm install && cd ../..
```

## Build

```bash
python docs/build/make_assets.py     # prepare images
node docs/build/build_doc.js         # write the .docx
```

## Adding screenshots

Save each capture into `docs/screenshots/` using these exact filenames:

| File | What to capture |
|---|---|
| `s01-repo-readme.png` | GitHub repo landing page with folder structure and README |
| `s02-branches.png` | Branches page: `main` plus `feat/us-16-public-status-page` |
| `s03-issues.png` | Issues list showing the 25 stories with labels |
| `s04-project-board.png` | Project board, view set to Group by → MoSCoW |
| `s05-docker-build.png` | Terminal: `docker compose up --build` finishing |
| `s06-compose-ps.png` | Terminal: `docker compose ps`, all five up and healthy |
| `s07-worker-logs.png` | Terminal: `docker compose logs --tail 20 worker` |
| `s08-dashboard.png` | Browser at `localhost:3000`, signed in, address bar visible |
| `s09-detail.png` | Browser: monitor detail with the response-time chart |
| `s10-status-page.png` | Browser: `localhost:3000/status/demo` |

`.jpg` also works. Then re-run both commands above. Any filename still missing
gets a labelled placeholder frame instead, so the document always builds.

## Verifying

```bash
soffice --headless --convert-to pdf Vigil_Digital_Assignment_1.docx
pdftotext -layout Vigil_Digital_Assignment_1.pdf - | head -40
```

Expected: 32 pages, exactly one landscape page (the architecture diagram),
all 25 story IDs present.

## Where the content comes from

| Part of the document | Source |
|---|---|
| Vision document (§1) | Prose in `build_doc.js`, mirroring `README.md` §1 |
| User stories (§2) | `scripts/stories.sh` → `assets/stories.json` |
| Wireframes (§3) | `docs/wireframes/*.svg`, generated by `scripts/make_wireframes.py` |
| Architecture (§4) | `infra/architecture.svg`, generated by `scripts/make_architecture_svg.py` |
| Dev setup (§5) | Prose in `build_doc.js`, mirroring `README.md` §§2–7 |

`scripts/stories.sh` is the single source of truth for the backlog: the GitHub
issue seeder, the project board script, and this document all read from it.
